phrases.text: Measure CL asks the voters of this city whether to limit City Council members to four four-year terms in a lifetime.
Today, the city has no term limits for its elected officials.
State law lets a city like this one limit council terms if a majority of its voters approve, and the City Council placed Measure CL on the ballot.
No one could serve more than four full terms, even with a break between them.
Filling the rest of a vacant seat would not count as a full term, so some members could serve more than 16 years.
Terms being served now would not count toward the limit.
The county Registrar's list of measures does not include a cost estimate for the measure.
No argument against Measure CL was submitted, according to the county Registrar's official list of ballot measures.
Supporters say a four-term limit ensures no one serves indefinitely, while preserving the experience needed to lead.
A yes vote approves the proposed term limits.
A no vote rejects the proposed term limits.
